subject.title: [Bug]: Preflight compaction failure permanently locks Composer into "terminated" state

question: Which open candidate should be treated as the canonical fix for this issue's preflight compaction retryability contract?
rationale: The bug is real and source-reproducible, but three open PRs overlap and prior maintainer feedback rejected broad retryability changes that can mask auth or request-shape failures.

options.title: Adopt the narrowed runtime guard
options.body: Treat https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/pull/101241 or an equivalent branch as canonical once real behavior proof or an explicit proof override is available.

options.title: Repair the classifier-split branch
options.body: Use https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/pull/101285 only after it reuses or fully mirrors the shared billing/entitlement 429 contract and adds negative controls.

options.title: Switch to UI recovery
options.body: Reject fail-open runtime behavior and pursue gateway/UI lifecycle recovery instead, accepting that compaction provider errors remain terminal at the preflight boundary.

recommendation.title: Adopt the narrowed runtime guard
recommendation.body: Treat https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/pull/101241 or an equivalent branch as canonical once real behavior proof or an explicit proof override is available.

likelyOwner.reason: Vincent gave the prior retryability-boundary feedback and recently touched the central compaction classifier/runtime path.
